newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Illovo in 21 mln rand Kenyan mill upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Illovo in 21 mln rand Kenyan mill upgrade.

text.p: Illovo Sugar Ltd has signed a 21 million rand deal to rehabilitate a sugar mill in Western Kenya, the company said on Wednesday.

Illovo managing director Don Macleod said the contract to rehabilitate the mill operated by the South Nyanza Sugar Company Ltd would take about 14 months and was part of the company's drive to expand its international interests.

"The contract covers the project management for the rehabilitation and interim expansion of the mill...as well as effect increases in factory time efficiency and overall recovery of sugar from cane," Macleod said in a statement.
The mill is one of seven operating in Kenya and was opened in 1980.
Macleod said once phase one of the project was completed, it was hoped that its annual production capacity would be increased to over 78,000 tonnes from the 68,700 tonnes in 1995/96.
